body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. The target's next successful attack before your next turn may push one damaged enemy 1 unit.

surges.html: The target may move 1 unit after the push.
The target reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Rite - Imbuement
rider.html: Rite, 1 Echo: bind the target. Trigger: it ends voluntary movement beside a hostile creature. Echo: it gains +1 Harmony against the next attack targeting it before your next turn.
